record_scope_reconstruction: The named location is the inland Kalpaki road junction where EO22 towards Kakavia branches from EO20 towards Konitsa/Mertzani. Reports concern intermittent approach obstructions; neither Kakavia nor Mertzani customs installations are demonstrated shut.

source_checks.finding: ERT February20 original names the Kalpaki obstruction on the road leading to Kakavia and Mertzani customs. It reports10:00 start, an actual one-hour opening until14:00 and bus/vulnerable exceptions; later end/bypass times are plans.
CNN February21 original places confrontation at Kalpaki junction, where police moved tractors aside but an actual sit-in then blocked the road towards Kakavia/Konitsa.

EpirusPost February20 original places vehicles and agricultural machinery at Kalpaki junction, with police-directed alternatives towards Kakavia and Konitsa. The named junction, not a border booth, is the spatial anchor.
EpirusPost February23 original confirms continued daily symbolic actions at Kalpaki and difficult Kakavia access. Weekend continuation remains prospective.

Original OSM history: node295227450 version5 September12 2023 at20.6236301,39.8895736, the last mapped node position before the February2024 event. Current version6 is a nearby2025 edit and is not silently substituted.
Original OSM way970431631 version2 February9 2023 names Kalpaki–Kakavia road, refEO22/E853, and begins at node295227450.
Original OSM way970431632 version2 September12 2023 names Kozani–Ioannina EO20 and ends at node295227450. Shared pre-event topology identifies the road branch at Kalpaki.

sites.name: Kalpaki EO20–EO22 inland road junction
sites.coordinate_method: Original OSM node295227450 version5 September12 2023 coordinates, shared by pre-event2023 versions of EO20 road970431632 and named Kalpaki–Kakavia EO22 road970431631.
sites.precision: Named junction-area reference; tens of metres of practical positional uncertainty for the protest. Decimal coordinates identify the historical mapped junction, not surveyed protester or bypass locations.
sites.evidence_note: Contemporaneous originals name Kalpaki junction and roads serving Kakavia/Mertzani. Pre-event OSM histories identify the actual EO20/EO22 junction, distinct from Kalpaki village centroid and later proposed A5 interchange. This is an inland approach obstruction, not either customs facility.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Kalpaki inland road junction affecting road access toward Kakavia and Mertzani, with reported bus/vulnerable-traveller exceptions. No symmetric border-admission prohibition or separate customs-post closure is inferred.

date_scope_check.assessment: February20 actual obstruction and a one-hour reopening until14:00, February21 sit-in and February23 daily symbolic continuation remain separate intermittent observations. Planned23:00 finish,17:30 bypass blockade and future weekend continuation are not established completions. Do not extend onset to an earlier Saturday mentioned retrospectively or infer four continuous closed days.

unresolved: Exact protesters’ positions and each secondary bypass obstruction are not georeferenced. The named inland junction is located; the customs facilities themselves are not shown closed.
